description: This file contains shell functions related to Zyxel device firmware upgrade procedures, including extracting root filesystem info, flashing firmware, and orchestrating the upgrade process.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from the kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the process of flashing kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive to specified device nodes, including setting up loop devices and formatting the new root filesystem.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the firmware upgrade process, determining the device specifics and invoking the flash procedure.
